Putting an initial proposal below (high level) — I’ll attach a proper pricing exhibits PDF once Jordan confirms the ramp we’re working to. We want to keep the MAP flexible but protect unit economics.

Proposed approach:
- Baseline unit price: $0.00012 / token for first 50M in Month 1 (trial)
- Month 2-3 tier: $0.00010 / token for 150M–350M range (applied to consumed tokens in that tier)
- Month 4+ tier: $0.00008 / token for 600M+ sustained months (sustained = 2 consecutive months at or above threshold)
- Cumulative commit discount: additional 10% rebate applied at the end of Month 6 if cumulative tokens >= 3B across first 6 months
- Trial credit: we can offer up to $25k in service credits applied to the first invoice if PulseAI signs the MAP and hits the Month 2 acceptance gate.

SLA: we can commit to p95 <350ms for the configured endpoint in the hosted region (US-West) and offer a service credit equal to 5% of that month’s invoice for any month where p95 > 350ms on more than 2 system-wide incidents. We’ll scope out exact incident definitions in the SOW.

Open items I need from you: (1) confirm whether PulseAI wants the SLA regionalized (US vs EU), (2) whether legal requires a hard commit on monthly minimums or if a staged commit language is acceptable (we prefer staged language with step-down credits vs hard minimums).

I’ll draft the pricing-exhibits.pdf and SOW-draft-v3.docx with the language above.

— Marissa
